anchors: [0, floor((N-1)/2), N-1] native decoded indices; duplicates explicitly retained
pixel: ffmpeg -noautorotate; no temporal/spatial resampling before full native RGB24 SHA; first video stream; select then showinfo
dHash: Pillow RGB.convert(L), resize((9,8),BOX), row-major adjacent horizontal left>right, first bit most significant
low_information: 9x8 grayscale population stddev<=5 OR dHash popcount<4 OR >60; each view evaluated separately
single_anchor: any anchor, any view combination, Hamming<=4, both informative; singleton is not video ancestry
multi_anchor: corresponding first/middle/last, fixed view pair, all Hamming<=8, at least 2 informative corresponding pairs and 3 distinct native indices per video
exact_RGB: dimensions+RGB SHA group regardless low information; low-information groups are group lists, not ancestry pair expansion
search: lossless pigeonhole 5 disjoint bit blocks for single distance4; 9 blocks on middle hash for distance8 then all3 distances; no cross-pool/role restrictions
low_information_pair_scope: single-anchor search excludes low-information views by declared rule; multi uses all middle hashes but needs2informative anchors
negative_interpretation: no candidate is not proof of global independence; known edges retained; no fuzzy merge
